author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete 


**oxoglutarate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity (GO:0034602); consider:** 
BP: 2-oxoglutarate decarboxylation to succinyl-CoA GO:0120551
MF: oxoglutarate dehydrogenase (succinyl-transferring) activity GO:0004591
MF: dihydrolipoyllysine-residue succinyltransferase activity GO:0004149
MF: dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase activity GO:0004148


**branched-chain alpha-keto acid dehydrogenase activity (GO:0047101); consider:**

BP: branched-chain alpha-keto acid decarboxylation to branched-chain acyl-CoA GO:0120552
MF: 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate dehydrogenase (2-methylpropanoyl-transferring) activity GO:0003863
MF: dihydrolipoyllysine-residue (2-methylpropanoyl)transferase activity GO:0043754
MF: dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase activity GO:0004148


see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29951

Impacted groups: 


Group | Count
-- | --
CACAO | 1
ComplexPortal | 1
FlyBase | 7
MGI | 4
RGD | 1

Annotations are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/13PymSYWhi3avIaNQ0Il4L8sp2HanpMONmO849B5iGRE/edit?gid=0#gid=0
